drop table if exists [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType]
CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [SubjectUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Subject] [varchar](50) NULL, [SubjectID] [int] NULL, [SubjectCardinality] [int] NOT NULL, [ObjectUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [ObjectCardinality] [int] NOT NULL, [PredicateUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [PredicateID] [int] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [IsNew] [bit] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL,
CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionRelationshipType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY]
